\section*{Problem Sheet 1: Kinematics}

\begin{enumerate}

\item A particle of mass $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ follows the path
  $\vec{r}(t) = 15 t \hat{\jmath} - 5 t^2 \hat{k}$. Find the force acting on
  it at time $t$.

\item Two ships sail from the same point. Are they on a crash course? If not,
  find their distance of closest approach.

% The display maths begins with the author's own minus sign, which the
% stray-minus check must not flag in a document pandoc converted.
\item The potential of a dipole on its axis is
  \[
  -\frac{p}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 z^2}.
  \]
  Find the field at a distance $z$.

\end{enumerate}
